issue.title: Fix Concurrent Snapshot Repository Remove Issues

labels.name: :Distributed/Snapshot/Restore
labels.description: Anything directly related to the `_snapshot/*` APIs

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
We need to fail repository operations as soon as a repository has been shut down
to avoid getting into broken cluster state situations where operations are created
in the cluster state but the repository they target was removed concurrently.

closes #74858
